title: improv·artist · haunted (Louise Bourgeois)
mutation_directive: improv artist: haunted via Louise Bourgeois

improv_extras.practice: spider, cell, charged intimate object; latex and bronze as memory

v1.feedback: The spider-over-cage composition is conceptually strong and the differential growth on the legs is a genuine algorithmic choice that earns its complexity. Two concerns: the shader's full color palette is truncated so verify the bronze tones don't wash out under additive blending into hot amber — consider clamping final RGB in the fragment shader. The cage bars (12 near-straight vertical threads with tiny sinusoidal wobble) read more as a curtain than Bourgeois's glass-and-steel Cell enclosures — try giving them differential growth too, or adding horizontal ring-connectors at 2-3 heights so the cage reads as a volumetric enclosure rather than dangling strings.
v1.raw:
I've now reviewed the visible code (the shader tail was truncated but I can assess the architecture). Here's my analysis:

**No banned techniques detected:**
- No `autoRotate = true`
- No per-frame camera jitter
- Custom `uFogColor`/`uFogDensity` uniforms instead of three.js auto-injected fog (avoids shader compile failure)
- No fast rotation increments
- BG `0x060504` — near-black, restrained

**Concept mapping is strong:** Eight differentially-grown legs from elevated body to ground anchors (Maman), cage bars beneath (Cell series), dripping particles, breathing pulse — the Bourgeois reference is structural, not decorative.

v2.feedback: The Bourgeois concept lands well — spider arching over a cage-cell with an egg sac is immediately legible and emotionally charged. The differential-growth legs are the strongest element; consider giving the cage bars more organic distortion (warped verticals, uneven ring heights) so the cell feels as psychologically oppressive as Bourgeois's actual Cells rather than a clean geometric enclosure. The egg sac is currently a random spheroid scatter — suspending it from visible thread-lines descending from the thorax would strengthen the Maman reference and add vertical tension. Verify the final palette values in the truncated rendering section stay clamped to the promised tarnished-bronze/bone-ash range; any additive glow on the eggs would break the restrained mood.

threejs.directive: Merge all legs and cage bars into one BufferGeometry with drawRange, using webgl_lines_fat for width-varied threads instead of LineBasicMaterial.
